Effective line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Please stay behind the rope. There is a rope.
Suggested line: THE CROWD! GOES! WILD! (normal voice) Could the crowd please stay behind the rope? I put up a rope.

Effective line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) I'm having soup. THE SOUP IS WINNING.
Suggested line: INTERMISSION! (normal voice) Everybody sit down a minute. I've brought a flask of soup, and my voice needs it more than I do.

Effective line: VICTORY ON THE SAND - THE PRIZE IS YOURS! The echo would like it known that it believed in you first.
Suggested line: VICTORY ON THE SAND - THE PRIZE IS YOURS! (normal voice) Mind your head on the way up to collect it. The ceiling doesn't celebrate.

Effective line: ANOTHER WIN FOR THE BOOKS! (normal voice) Some coins for you. From the crowd. The crowd is me.
Suggested line: ANOTHER WIN FOR THE BOOKS! (normal voice) Here's a few coins from the crowd. The crowd is me, but I mean every one of them.

Effective line: PUZZLE SOLVED - THE CROWD GOES WILD! A triumph for thinking, shouted at full volume!
Suggested line: PUZZLE SOLVED - THE CROWD GOES WILD! (normal voice) Lovely bit of thinking, that. I could hear the gears turning from the booth.

Effective line: THE PUZZLE WINS THIS ROUND! (normal voice) Study the board. Try again. It's not going anywhere.
Suggested line: THE PUZZLE WINS THIS ROUND! (normal voice) Have a good long look at the board and try again. It's not going anywhere, and neither am I.

Effective line: No station yet. Walk into the town there and a cousin will wake up and rip one into the wall.
Suggested line: No station yet. Walk into that town yourself and a cousin will turn up and rip one into the nearest wall.

Effective line: Ripping out of a zone ends your visit: you arrive at full HP, and the roaming enemies there come back. Rips are free. Beefcakes charge for spotting, and spotting is also free.
Suggested line: Ripping out of a zone ends your visit: you arrive at full HP, and the roaming enemies there come back. Rips are free, and so is the spotting.

Effective line: The elevator lobby. A cousin ripped it into the wall beside the Out-Of-Order sign. It is the only thing in the building that works.
Suggested line: The elevator lobby, where a cousin ripped it into the wall beside the Out-Of-Order sign. It's the only thing in the building that works.

Effective line: A short walk from the heavy meal table. The cousin ripped it open just by the napkins.
Suggested line: A short walk from the heavy meal table. The cousin ripped it open right by the napkins, so you'll never arrive without one.

Effective line: Right by the harvest table. The Rip is slightly damp. So is everything.
Suggested line: Right by the harvest table. The Rip on duty is slightly damp, but then so is everything else out there.

Effective line: A rip into the hideout under the Capital. Do not ask how we found it. We followed the smell of Fig Sly's hot sauce through the fabric of space.
Suggested line: A rip into the hideout under the Capital. Don't ask how we found it; we followed the smell of Fig Sly's hot sauce straight through the fabric of space.

Effective line: The sky is surprisingly heavy. Do NOT skip sky day. And do not look at the seam. It is not a seam. It is a PUMP.
Suggested line: The sky is heavier than it looks, buddy, so we never skip sky day. Do not look at the seam. It's working very hard and it's shy about it.

Effective line: Reach a town and we send a cousin to rip a station there. All named Rip; around cousin four, naming became a cooldown exercise.
Suggested line: Reach a new town and we send a cousin to rip a station there. Every one of them is called Rip. Our mother found a name she liked and saw no reason to stop.

Effective line: Back for another rip, little buddy? Say where, and we will tear it right open. Rips are free.
Suggested line: Back for another rip, buddy? Say where and we'll tear it right open. Rips are free, same as always.

Effective line: Spotting is free, buddy. Hydration is a bring-your-own-water situation.
Suggested line: Spotting is free, buddy. Water, sadly, you'll have to bring yourself.

Effective line: Shhh. Keep it down, there is a Wrinkle sleeping behind the crates. Rip Tearson, Cousin #7, Rift Express. Allegedly.
Suggested line: Shhh. Keep it down, buddy, there's a Wrinkle asleep behind the crates. Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Seven, Rift Express. Allegedly.

Effective line: I was told this place did not exist, so I ripped a hole to it. Sometimes you just have to want it. And the sauce smell helped.
Suggested line: They told me this place didn't exist, so I ripped a hole to it anyway. Sometimes you just have to believe in yourself. The sauce smell helped.

Effective line: Spot this whole dimension, brother! Lift with your LEGS - lower back does not mean lower universe!
Suggested line: Spot this whole dimension, brother! Lift with your LEGS! Nobody ever tore the sky open with their lower back!

Effective line: You check for an approved way to have arrived. The memo offers none.
Suggested line: You turn the memo over, looking for an approved way to have arrived. There isn't one.

Effective line: You land in the Pantry and receive a napkin before you find your balance. Priorities are immaculate.
Suggested line: You land in the Pantry, and someone hands you a napkin before you've found your feet.

Effective line: You arrive at the Grange in a whiff of ozone, mulch and gym sock. The Express leaves a personal impression.
Suggested line: You arrive at the Grange in a whiff of ozone, mulch and gym sock, and the gym sock is definitely the Express.

Effective line: A hasty rip where you first woke up, between the trees. There is a hatch in the clearing now that nobody remembers being there. It smells like a hospital.
Suggested line: A hasty rip between the trees where you first woke up. There's a hatch south of the clearing now that nobody remembers being there, and it smells like a hospital.

Effective line: Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Eight, rift technician, tree enthusiast. This is the clearing where I found the hatch, buddy. I did not open it.
Suggested line: HNNNGH. Rip Tearson, Cousin Number Eight, rift technician and tree enthusiast. This is where I found the hatch, buddy, and no, I didn't open it.

Effective line: Say the word and I will rip you back to {town}. Or you can go down the hatch. I will hold the sky.
Suggested line: Say the word and I'll rip you back to {town}. Or, if you're going down the hatch, I'll hold the sky open till you're back up.

Effective line: Need a rip back to {town}, or are you heading down the hatch? Either way, I have been holding this sky since breakfast.
Suggested line: Back to {town}, buddy, or down the hatch? Either way, I've been holding this sky since breakfast and it's ready when you are.

Effective line: I went exploring up there, and I saw some very interesting things. The brambles south of the clearing just... let go. There is a path now, and at the end of it a hatch that was NOT there before. Little glowing roots. A smell like a hospital.
Suggested line: I went up there on my day off and saw some very interesting things. The brambles south of the clearing just... let go, and there's a path now, with a hatch at the end that was NOT there before. Glowing roots, and a hospital smell.

Effective line: Sable, Tilly and Pip, dearie, all on the square. And buy a card from Sable. You are not leaving this town with only what a cave gave you.
Suggested line: Sable, Tilly and Pip, dearie, all three on the square. And buy a card from Sable while you're there. I'll not have you facing the roads with nothing but what a cave gave you.

Effective line: Back already. Sable charmed you, Tilly was a colour, Pip measured you. That is {town}, dearie. Try leaving with the same hat.
Suggested line: Back already? Let me guess: Sable charmed you, Tilly turned a colour, and Pip measured you before you'd finished saying hello. That's {town}, dearie.

Effective line: Here: a trophy. Everybody gets one. I made it myself, so participate carefully.
Suggested line: Here, have a trophy. Everybody gets one, so don't let it go to your head. I made it myself, and the handle comes off if you wave it about.

Effective line: A deck you never chose is a deck you will lose with, says Maren. New cards first, then make the deck your own.
Suggested line: Maren says a deck you never chose is a deck you'll lose with. Open a pack for some new cards, then make the deck your own at the Deck Station.

Effective line: Now that deck of yours. A deck you never chose is a deck you will lose with.
Suggested line: Now, about that deck of yours. You didn't choose a single card in it, dearie, and a deck you never chose is a deck you'll lose with.

Effective line: New cards first. Open a pack: the Menu, top right, then Packs. Or press P, if you are the sort who presses things.
Suggested line: New cards first, so open a pack: the Menu at the top right, then Packs. Or press P, if you're the sort who presses things.

Effective line: Then the Deck Station, down Champions' Road south of the square. Swap what you like, save it to a slot, and come and tell me.
Suggested line: Then take it to the Deck Station, down Champions' Road south of the square. Swap in whatever you like, save it to a slot, and come and tell me how it went.

Effective line: No packs at all? Here, dearie. A General Pack. Slightly sat on. Cards are cards.
Suggested line: No packs at all? Here, dearie, have a General Pack. It's been sat on a little. Cards are cards, and these ones won't hold it against you.

Effective line: Open the pack first, dearie. Menu, then Packs. It will not open itself. I have asked.
Suggested line: Open the pack first, dearie: the Menu, then Packs. It won't open itself. I've asked it nicely.

Effective line: The Deck Station, dearie. Champions' Road, south of the square. Save it to a slot, or it doesn't count. I check.
Suggested line: The Deck Station is down Champions' Road, south of the square, dearie. Save it to a slot when you're done, or it doesn't count. I do check.

Effective line: Sorted and saved. Your own deck, at last. Now you may take personal offence when it loses.
Suggested line: Sorted and saved, and every card in it your own choice. Good. Now when it loses, you've nobody to blame but yourself, which is how it ought to be.

Effective line: Tilly Tonic's store room has been rattling, moaning and refusing visitors. Maren would like it to stop. So would Tilly.
Suggested line: Tilly Tonic's store room has been rattling and moaning for a week, and nobody can get in. Maren wants it sorted, and so, very much, does Tilly.

Effective line: Now, a favour. Tilly's store room, the corner house beside her shop, has been moaning for a week. Not Tilly. The room.
Suggested line: Now, a favour. Tilly's store room, the corner house beside her shop, has been moaning for a week. I don't mean Tilly, dearie. I mean the room.

Effective line: Ghosts, I expect. Petty ones: the worst kind. Nobody can get in for so much as a candle. Go and sort them out. Gently, if they let you.
Suggested line: Ghosts, I expect, and petty ones, which are the worst kind. Nobody's been able to get in for so much as a candle. Go and sort them out, gently if they'll let you.

Effective line: The store room door, beside Tilly's shop on the north side of the square. Ignore the rattling. That is just them being dramatic.
Suggested line: The store room door is beside Tilly's shop, on the north side of the square. Ignore the rattling, dearie; that's just them being dramatic.

Effective line: A refund. Ninety years of haunting, over a refund. I have had customers like that. I still have one.
Suggested line: A refund? Ninety years of moaning, all over one broken lantern. I've had customers like that. I still have a few.

Effective line: Well done, dearie. You settled the ghosts. Next, settle yourself somewhere dry.
Suggested line: Well done, dearie. You've settled the ghosts, so now go and settle yourself somewhere dry before you catch a chill.

Effective line: Maren says it is time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear, by the book: report to his smithy and win him one fight.
Suggested line: Maren says it's time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear strictly by the book: report to his smithy, then win one fight to earn it.

Effective line: Right. Time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth issues gear, at the smithy on the west side of the square.
Suggested line: Right, then. It's time you had something sharper than a deck. Bertram Beetsworth hands out gear from his smithy, on the west side of the square.

Effective line: Bertram's smithy, west side of the square. Win him a fight, any fight, and he will stamp something. He lives to stamp something.
Suggested line: Bertram's smithy is on the west side of the square. Win him one fight, any fight at all, and he'll stamp something for you. He lives to stamp things.

Effective line: The Paths quarrel, dearie. Beefcake against Necrocrat, Gourmand against Refusemancer. Since before the roads. Possibly because of them.
Suggested line: The Paths quarrel, dearie: Beefcake against Necrocrat, Gourmand against Refusemancer. They always have. Once, they needed each other too much for it to matter.

Effective line: Evening! Old Hob. I dig. Not much call for it these ten years. Nobody's been collected, you see. Paperwork. Heh.
Suggested line: Evening! Old Hob, at your service. I dig, mostly, though there's not been much call for it these ten years. Nobody's been collected, you see. Paperwork. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's have a look for you... hm. Not for a good long while yet. Lovely! That's what I like to see.

Effective line: Mind the cairn at the end of the row. Something under it is still counting its turns. Rude to keep it waiting. Heh.
Suggested line: Mind the cairn at the end of the row. Something under it is still counting its turns, and it's rude to keep a thing like that waiting. Heh.

Effective line: Still digging. Slowly. Two particular graves, these ten years. I like to take my time with the important ones. Heh.
Suggested line: Still digging, slowly. Two particular graves, these ten years now. I like to take my time over the important ones. Heh.

Effective line: Appointments. Let's see. You... hm. Not for a good long while. Ha! Lovely.
Suggested line: Appointments. Let's have a look for you... hm. Not for a good long while yet. Lovely! That's what I like to see.

Effective line: {villain} is gone, but Rip found something in the forest where you first woke: a hatch that was not there before. Something under it feels like yours. So does someone.
Suggested line: {villain} is gone, but Rip found something in the forest where you first woke: a hatch that wasn't there before. Whatever is down there feels like yours, and so does someone.

Effective line: Elder Maren wants you fed, kitted out and known in town. Say hello to the shopkeepers on the square and buy yourself a card. There is a trophy in it. Everyone gets the trophy.
Suggested line: Elder Maren wants you fed, kitted out and known in town. Say hello to the shopkeepers on the square and buy yourself a card. There's a trophy in it, though everyone gets the trophy.

Effective line: The kettle's on and the pie is cooling. Neither is for you. Both are for you.
Suggested line: Kettle's on and the pie's cooling. Neither's for you, dearie. Well. Both are.

Effective line: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll fix it when you know.
Suggested line: Hm. Wrote you in the book. 'Stranger, damp.' I'll add a name when you've got one.

Effective line: Two typos, darling. One misprint. Such a small card, such a complicated past.
Suggested line: Two typos and a misprint, darling. Such a small card, such a complicated past.

Effective line: Fresh tonics! Tested them all this morning! I'm teal! Teal means it works!
Suggested line: Fresh tonics! I tested every one this morning, and I'm teal, so they work!

Effective line: Emergency tonic! Works on Tuesdays too! That's when I test the emergency tonic!
Suggested line: Emergency tonic! I keep inventing new emergencies just to test it on!

Effective line: Fact: bears cannot open the drawer. Nobody opens the drawer. Protocol Three.
Suggested line: Fact: bears cannot open the drawer. Neither can you. Security Protocol Three.

Effective line: Hydration. Stretching. Sorry, am I ordering again? I meant we could do them together.
Suggested line: Water, then a stretch. Sorry, was that an order? I meant we could do them together.

Effective line: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again. Occupational dusting. Anyone want a roll?
Suggested line: Fresh bread! Flour in my whiskers again, but the rolls came out lovely. Want one?

Effective line: I knead a holiday. Then I knead the dough. Busy, busy badger.
Suggested line: I knead a holiday, but the dough won't hear of it. Busy, busy badger.

Effective line: The old cottage cheers at night now. From the cellar. I'm choosing to love it.
Suggested line: The old cottage cheers at night now, from the cellar. I've decided to find it lovely.

Effective line: Armed, are we. Good. Now, where to point you. Start with {zone}, dearie. It is {path} country, and so are you.
Suggested line: Armed now, are we? Good. Then it's time I pointed you somewhere. Start with {zone}, dearie. It's {path} country, and so, by the look of you, are you.

Effective line: {vendor} sells more {path} cards there than anyone in this town. Take gold. Take a bag. Take my advice, for once.
Suggested line: {vendor} sells more {path} cards out there than anyone in this town does, so take gold and a good big bag. And take my advice, for once.

Effective line: And inside {zone}, your Path stands taller. {buff}: {buff_text}
Suggested line: Inside {zone}, your Path stands a little taller. {buff}: {buff_text}

Effective line: So in {zone} the {rival} side gets the short end. {debuff}: {debuff_text} In {rival_zone}, it is your turn to suffer.
Suggested line: So in {zone}, it's the {rival} side that gets the short end. {debuff}: {debuff_text} In {rival_zone}, it's the other way round, and you're the one who suffers.

Effective line: {gatekeeper} holds the way in. Win that fight first. Then come back alive. Pie is not cheap.
Suggested line: {gatekeeper} holds the way in, and you'll have to win that fight before anything else. Then come back alive. I'll have a pie waiting, and I don't bake for people who don't come back.
